nodes.label: ADR-023 — Escopo de plataforma da v1: pt-BR, auth local, HTTP interno, Compose on-prem
Decision: pt-BR-only UI, local user/password auth (Argon2/bcrypt + JWT), plain HTTP on plant network, Docker Compose on a single on-prem Linux host
nodes.rationale: Zero dependency on corporate infrastructure (IdP, web PKI) to install at a plant; TLS/LDAP remain future evolution with no architectural impact (proxy/keycloak can be added later). Services: frontend, api, opc-worker, flow-runtime, recorder, redis, timescaledb.
